text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Jan Smerek, President of steel maker VSZ, said he considered the postponement of bank privatisation as a bad decision, saying the delay will not solve the problems of banking sector.
- Smerek has denied rumours that VSZ is interested in acquiring 51 percent in any bank.

- The National Property Fund, the state privatisation agency, has so far approved 192 out of 308 requests by new owners of privatised property to repay their debts with privatsiation bonds purchased from citizens.
- The government holds it regular session on Tuesday. The preliminary agenda does not include any major economic items.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - VSZ said it planned to gradually increase its annual turnover to around 100 billion crowns, from the current 50 billion.
- The economics ministry has 84 state companies currently undergoing bankruptcy procedures.

PRAVDA - New rules for trading with privatisation bonds, banning trades at prices lower than the state-guaranteed minimum of 7,500 crowns with financial settlement outside the entitled organiser of the trade, came into effect on Monday.

SME - The opposition Party of Democratic Left (SDL) said the government was fully responsible for the current crisis in trading with privatisation bonds, when citizens were selling their bonds for lower prices than the guaranteed minimum of 7,500 crowns.
